title: 实验室火灾的预防
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/031_实验室火灾的预防.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/031_实验室火灾的预防/src.py

points.K1: 实验室火灾不多，但损失大
points.K2: 消防有法规，人人有责任
points.K3: 认清实验室的火灾隐患
points.K5: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
points.K6: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火
points.K7: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放
points.K10: 私用电器不进实验室，插线板不串接
points.K11: 可燃废料和油抹布及时清走
points.K12: 用完关设备，离开前查水电气
points.S1: 过夜运行要报批，挂牌留联系方式

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁关掉加热板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot switches off a hot plate beside a tidy lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室火灾的预防。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰用沾了溶剂的纸巾擦完台面，随手丢在加热板旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the bench with a solvent-soaked tissue and drops it next to a hot plate.
shots.narration: 阿杰把沾溶剂的纸巾，丢在加热板旁。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 加热板开着，阿杰转身离开实验室
shots.prompt_en: The hot plate stays on as the young male student leaves the lab.
shots.narration: 加热板没关，他就走了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 纸巾冒烟起火，画面定格打叉
shots.prompt_en: The tissue near the hot plate starts to smoke and catch fire; the frame freezes with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没多久，纸巾就冒烟起火了。

shots.section_title: 实验室火灾不多，但损失大
shots.scene: 实验室起火概率低、后果严重的天平示意
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: a small flame icon on one side outweighs a pile of instruments and data on the other. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室起火不多，但风险很大。
overlay: 实验室火灾不多，但损失大

shots.section_title: 实验室火灾不多，但损失大
shots.scene: 烧伤、烟气、仪器、数据样本四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a burn, smoke, a lab instrument and a sample rack with data. No text.
shots.narration: 伤人、毁仪器、烧掉多年的数据样本。

shots.section_title: 实验室火灾不多，但损失大
shots.scene: 火让化学品散出，污染环境的示意
shots.prompt_en: Smoke from a lab fire carries chemical particles outside the building. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品还会散出去，污染环境。

shots.section_title: 实验室火灾不多，但损失大
shots.scene: 预防、发现、应对三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a shield, an alarm bell and an extinguisher. No text.
shots.narration: 消防就是预防、早发现、会应对。

shots.section_title: 消防有法规，人人有责任
shots.scene: 法规书本和学校制度文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A law book icon and a school regulation folder icon side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 防火有消防法，也有学校规定。
overlay: 消防有法规，人人有责任

shots.section_title: 消防有法规，人人有责任
shots.scene: 单位和个人两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: An institution building icon and a person icon both get green checks. No text.
shots.narration: 单位和个人，都有消防责任。

shots.section_title: 消防有法规，人人有责任
shots.scene: 王老师和小研对照清单查找火灾隐患
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student check a lab for fire hazards with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 做好火灾风险评估，找出隐患。

shots.section_title: 消防有法规，人人有责任
shots.scene: 偷工减料的消防器材被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cheap, broken extinguisher bracket and a missing alarm are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 消防上偷工减料，代价太大。

shots.section_title: 认清实验室的火灾隐患
shots.scene: 乙醇瓶、含醇消毒剂等易燃品
shots.prompt_en: Ethanol bottles and an alcohol-based disinfectant spray on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患一：乙醇等易燃试剂。
overlay: 认清实验室的火灾隐患

shots.section_title: 认清实验室的火灾隐患
shots.scene: 纸张、包装、塑料耗材
shots.prompt_en: Paper, packaging and plastic consumables stacked on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患二：纸张、包装、塑料耗材。

shots.section_title: 认清实验室的火灾隐患
shots.scene: 酒精灯、电热设备、电火花
shots.prompt_en: An alcohol lamp, a hot plate, an oven and a small electrical spark. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患三：明火、电热设备和电火花。

shots.section_title: 认清实验室的火灾隐患
shots.scene: 线路老化和无人看管的明火，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A frayed cable and an unattended flame are both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 线路故障、无人看管，最常引发火灾。

shots.section_title: 严禁吸烟，明火要审批
shots.scene: 禁止吸烟标志，实验楼内
shots.prompt_en: A no smoking sign on the wall of a lab building corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 实验楼内，严禁吸烟。

shots.section_title: 严禁吸烟，明火要审批
shots.scene: 只能在楼外指定区域吸烟的示意
shots.prompt_en: A map icon shows a designated smoking area outside the building, far from the labs. No text.
shots.narration: 只能在学校指定的地点吸烟。

shots.section_title: 严禁吸烟，明火要审批
shots.scene: 王老师在空白审批单上签字，旁边是明火图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank approval form next to an open flame icon.
shots.narration: 确需明火，按规定审批、有人值守。

shots.section_title: 严禁吸烟，明火要审批
shots.scene: 楼内焊接切割要先办动火审批
shots.prompt_en: A welding torch icon beside a blank permit form with a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 楼里焊接切割，必须先办审批。

shots.section_title: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
shots.scene: 能用电热就不用明火，打勾
shots.prompt_en: An electric heating mantle gets a green check next to an alcohol lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 明火能少用就少用。
overlay: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭

shots.section_title: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
shots.scene: 用前清走周围易燃物
shots.prompt_en: Solvent bottles are moved away before a burner is lit. No faces.
shots.narration: 点火前，周围清走易燃物。

shots.section_title: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
shots.scene: 用一盏酒精灯去点另一盏，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Lighting one alcohol lamp from another is crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 不用一盏灯去点另一盏。

shots.section_title: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
shots.scene: 火开着人走开，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A burning flame left unattended while a person walks away, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 火开着，人不能离开。

shots.section_title: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
shots.scene: 【实拍】用灯帽盖灭酒精灯（手部特写，演示熄灭方法）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand places the cap over an alcohol lamp flame to put it out.
shots.narration: 用灯帽盖灭，不用嘴吹。

shots.section_title: 明火少用，人不离开，用完盖灭
shots.scene: 【实拍】关闭燃气灯后，再确认一次燃气阀已关（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand turns off a gas burner and checks the gas valve handle is in the off position.
shots.narration: 用完关阀，再确认一次。

shots.section_title: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火
shots.scene: 喷酒精消毒台面后，旁边点火，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Lighting a flame right after spraying alcohol on the bench is crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 喷完酒精消毒，先别点火。
overlay: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火

shots.section_title: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火
shots.scene: 手上酒精没干靠近火焰，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Wet alcohol-sanitized hands near a flame are crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 手上酒精没干，别靠近火焰。

shots.section_title: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火
shots.scene: 等酒精挥发干了再点灯
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon shows waiting until the bench is dry before lighting the lamp. No faces.
shots.narration: 等酒精挥发干了，再点灯。

shots.section_title: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火
shots.scene: 熄灭冷却后，再给酒精灯添加酒精
shots.prompt_en: An alcohol lamp is put out and cooled before it is refilled with a funnel. No faces.
shots.narration: 添酒精，先熄灭、等冷却。

shots.section_title: 酒精消毒后，等干了再点火
shots.scene: 清洁剂少量取用，废布放带盖桶
shots.prompt_en: A small amount of cleaner is used and the used cloth goes into a lidded metal bin. No faces.
shots.narration: 易燃清洁剂少量取用，远离热源。

shots.section_title: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放
shots.scene: 易燃溶剂瓶与加热板之间留出距离
shots.prompt_en: A clear distance is kept between flammable solvent bottles and a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物，远离热源。
overlay: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放

shots.section_title: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放
shots.scene: 热源的辐射热烤到旁边的易燃物
shots.prompt_en: Heat waves from a hot plate warm a nearby solvent bottle, shown with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不碰火焰，辐射热也能烤着。

shots.section_title: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放
shots.scene: 台面上多余的溶剂放回防火柜
shots.prompt_en: Extra solvent bottles are returned to a yellow flammables cabinet. No faces.
shots.narration: 台面少放，多余的放回防火柜。

shots.section_title: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放
shots.scene: 易燃液体用明火直接加热，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Heating a flask of flammable liquid directly over an open flame is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不用明火直接加热易燃液体。

shots.section_title: 易燃物远离热源，台面少放
shots.scene: 关了的加热板仍在冒热气
shots.prompt_en: A switched-off hot plate still shows rising heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 关了的加热板，余热还很高。

shots.section_title: 加热设备不无人值守
shots.scene: 家里做饭走开、锅里起火的借喻图
shots.prompt_en: A small cartoon thought bubble of an unattended cooking pot catching fire. No people.
shots.narration: 就像做饭不能走开。

shots.section_title: 加热设备不无人值守
shots.scene: 加热时人守在旁边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stays beside her heating setup, watching it.
shots.narration: 加热时，人不离开。

shots.section_title: 加热设备不无人值守
shots.scene: 【实拍】给加热设备设定定时器（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand sets a timer on a heating device.
shots.narration: 设好定时器提醒，到点就关。

shots.section_title: 加热设备不无人值守
shots.scene: 人离开前断电
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, the young male student switches off and unplugs the heater.
shots.narration: 人要离开，先断电。

shots.section_title: 高温灯具远离可燃物
shots.scene: 高温灯具周围放着纸张和溶剂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Paper and solvent bottles near a hot lamp are crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高温灯具周围，不放纸张溶剂。

shots.section_title: 高温灯具远离可燃物
shots.scene: 大功率照明灯固定牢靠
shots.prompt_en: A high-power work light is firmly mounted on a stand away from combustibles. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率灯具要固定牢。

shots.section_title: 高温灯具远离可燃物
shots.scene: 换灯前断电，等灯冷却
shots.prompt_en: A lamp is unplugged and a clock icon shows waiting for it to cool before replacing the bulb. No faces.
shots.narration: 换灯先断电，冷却后再动手。

shots.section_title: 私用电器不进实验室，插线板不串接
shots.scene: 实验室里的电水壶、取暖器，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An electric kettle and a space heater in a lab are crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电水壶、取暖器，不进实验室。
overlay: 私用电器不进实验室，插线板不串接

shots.section_title: 私用电器不进实验室，插线板不串接
shots.scene: 插线板一个接一个串联，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Power strips plugged into each other in a chain are crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接，不私拉电线。

shots.section_title: 私用电器不进实验室，插线板不串接
shots.scene: 老李检查配电和线路
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the lab's wiring and sockets.
shots.narration: 用电问题，找专业人员处理。

shots.section_title: 可燃废料和油抹布及时清走
shots.scene: 纸箱、木板、油抹布堆在一起
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes, wooden boards and oily rags piled together. No people.
shots.narration: 纸箱、木板、油抹布，遇火就着。
overlay: 可燃废料和油抹布及时清走

shots.section_title: 可燃废料和油抹布及时清走
shots.scene: 油抹布放进带盖铁桶
shots.prompt_en: Oily rags are placed into a lidded metal can. No faces.
shots.narration: 油抹布放进带盖铁桶。

shots.section_title: 可燃废料和油抹布及时清走
shots.scene: 可燃废料被及时清运出实验室
shots.prompt_en: Combustible waste is carried out of the lab for disposal. No faces.
shots.narration: 可燃废料，及时清走。

shots.section_title: 用完关设备，离开前查水电气
shots.scene: 工作结束，关掉不需通电的设备并拔插头
shots.prompt_en: At the end of the day, a person switches off equipment and unplugs what does not need power. No faces.
shots.narration: 工作结束，关设备，拔插头。
overlay: 用完关设备，离开前查水电气

shots.section_title: 用完关设备，离开前查水电气
shots.scene: 【实拍】离开前依次检查水龙头、电源、燃气阀（中景）
shots.prompt_en: A person checks the water tap, the power switch and the gas valve before leaving the lab.
shots.narration: 离开前，查一遍水、电、气。

shots.section_title: 用完关设备，离开前查水电气
shots.scene: 关窗、关灯、锁门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the window, turns off the lights and locks the door.
shots.narration: 关好门窗，关灯锁门再离开。

shots.section_title: 过夜运行要报批，挂牌留联系方式
shots.scene: 需过夜运行的设备旁，王老师在空白审批单签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank approval form beside an instrument that must run overnight.
shots.narration: 设备要过夜运行，先按规定报批。
overlay: 过夜运行要报批，挂牌留联系方式

shots.section_title: 过夜运行要报批，挂牌留联系方式
shots.scene: 设备上挂着空白运行信息牌和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank running-status tag with a phone icon hangs on the overnight instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 挂牌写明运行情况和联系人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 禁烟、明火盖灭、易燃物远离热源依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A no smoking sign, a capped alcohol lamp and solvents away from a hot plate get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 管住火源，易燃物远离热源。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 加热有人守、关水电气、锁门依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: An attended heater, switched-off utilities and a locked door get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 加热不离人，离开查水电气。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个灭火器，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a portable fire extinguisher and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲灭火器的种类与选用。
